outcome: surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis (SAP) compliance with Ghana Standard Treatment Guidelines
cohort: Patients undergoing surgery at Ho Teaching Hospital in Ghana between January and May 2021.
finding: Overall SAP compliance with the Ghana Standard Treatment Guidelines was 2.5%, primarily due to longer than recommended duration of prescription.
followup_time: Postoperative hospitalization duration was recorded, but specific timeframe for last observation is not mentioned.
